mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, balance, frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, total_recharge AS totalRecharge, total_spent AS totalSpent, status, update_time AS updateTime FROM `user_wallet` WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `user_wallet` SET total_spent = COALESCE(total_spent, 0) + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE `user_wallet` SET balance = balance - #{amount}, total_spent = COALESCE(total_spent, 0) + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE `user_wallet` SET balance = balance + #{amount}, total_spent = GREATEST(COALESCE(total_spent, 0) - #{amount}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
